Question:
For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
SELECT b.name, m.duration, w1.name, w2.name, m.title_change 
FROM Matches m 
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id 
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id 
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id 
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%' 
AND m.title_change = 0 
AND m.duration IS NOT NULL 
AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY m.duration 
LIMIT 5
